title: GCD of Odd and Even Sums
description:

n

sumOdd

sumEven
.

Output:
4

Sum of the first 4 odd numbers
sumOdd = 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 16

.
Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10​​​​​​​00
hints: The first n odd numbers sum to n * n
First n even numbers sum to n * (n + 1)
gcd(n, n + 1) = 1, so the answer is n
